\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXInt}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottmv{integer\_literal}  \ottsym{:}   [   \varnothing   ]  \ottkw{int} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Int}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXTrue}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottkw{true}  \ottsym{:}   [   \varnothing   ]  \ottkw{bool} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_True}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXFalse}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottkw{false}  \ottsym{:}   [   \varnothing   ]  \ottkw{bool} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_False}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXUnit}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottsym{()}  \ottsym{:}   [   \varnothing   ]  \ottkw{unit} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Unit}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXVarXXMono}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{:}   [   \ottmv{x}  :  \alpha   ]  \alpha }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Var\_Mono}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXVarXXPoly}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \Pi ( \ottmv{x} ) =  \mathcal{T} }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{:}  \mathcal{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Var\_Poly}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXAbs}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  \ottsym{,}  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \lambda  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{.}  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \rightarrow  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Abs}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXApp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \rightarrow  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}} }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_App}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXLet}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}} }%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \ottsym{,}  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta_{{\mathrm{2}}}  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottkw{let} \, \ottmv{x}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{in} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta_{{\mathrm{2}}}  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Let}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXIf}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \ottkw{bool} }%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau }%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{3}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottkw{if} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{then} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}} \, \ottkw{else} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{3}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_If}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXCons}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \quad \ottsym{,} \quad .. \quad \ottsym{,} \quad \Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau_{\ottmv{n}} }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottsym{\{}  \ottmv{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \ottmv{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \ottsym{\{}  \ottmv{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \ottmv{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{\ottmv{n}}  \ottsym{\}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Cons}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXProj}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \ottsym{\{}  \ottmv{l}  \ottsym{:}  \tau  \ottsym{\}} }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{.}  \ottmv{l}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Proj}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXVariant}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottmv{l} \, \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \ottsym{[}  \ottmv{l}  \ottsym{:}  \tau  \ottsym{]} }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Variant}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXSub}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau }%
\ottpremise{  [  \Delta  ]  \tau   \leq^{\forall}   [  \Delta'  ]  \tau'  }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta'  ]  \tau' }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Sub}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTXXRecXXMono}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Pi  \Vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  \ottsym{,}  \ottmv{f}  \ottsym{:}  \tau  ]  \tau }%
}{
\Pi  \Vdash  \ottkw{fix} \, \ottmv{f}  \ottsym{.}  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}   [  \Delta  ]  \tau }{%
{\ottdrulename{T\_Rec\_Mono}}{}%
}}
